newsitem.title: FRANCE: Woman is latest victim of French weather.
newsitem.headline: Woman is latest victim of French weather.

text.p: An 81-year-old woman who had been missing from a small east French mountain village since Saturday was found dead of cold in snow near her home on Tuesday, police said.

The woman's death and the discovery earlier on Tuesday of the body of a homeless man in the Lorraine area brought to about 30 the number of people killed in France by Arctic weather which has hit many areas of Europe since December 24.
